audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Neeko / Neeko / Skill x5. The packet chart reads Neeko / Mordekaiser x5 / Neeko, the win rate is 55.3% and the page is rated FAV 7/10.
audit.why: The page's own prose already says Mordekaiser wins rows 1-5 ('step up and bully', 'one combo halves a squishy mage', 'out-DPSes her', 'a near-guaranteed kill', 'makes the all-in lethal') and that Neeko takes the last row ('She out-scales the duel as a teamfight pick mage').
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group: 1-5 -> Mordekaiser, 6 -> Neeko. Level 1 stays Neeko.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ item row was written as a Mordekaiser spike ('Riftmaker turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable').
audit.why: Neeko's second-half spike is teamfight utility, not duelling: Pop Blossom (120/105/90s, 600 range) knocks up then stuns, and Inherent Glamour lets her hide the wind-up behind an ally disguise.
audit.corrected: 2+ items row rewritten to Neeko's teamfight spike; your spikes remain level 2-3, level 6 and first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs was described with no numbers, and nothing stated that it roots for longer after passing through a champion or minion.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs: 1000 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s; 'if the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer' — so standing behind your own wave makes the root worse, not safer.
audit.corrected: Track the 12s, commit when it misses, and do not eat it through a minion.

audit.whatIsWrong: brief.missingInteractions claims Obliterate grounds and therefore shuts off Pop Blossom. NOT WRITTEN TO THE PAGE.
audit.why: The 'grounding' flag on Mordekaiser Q is a tooltip-parsing false positive: Riot's text is 'smashes the ground with his mace', which is terrain wording, not a grounding effect. Per the brief's own rule, the description beats the flag.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim asserted anywhere. Listed as unverified instead.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Neeko's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Neeko turns into a teamfight pick mage: Pop Blossom's stun and an Inherent Glamour ally-disguise beat you in groups even while you still win the clean 1v1.

edits.before: He kites your slow kit — E-pull the step-up, then drag him into the Realm where he can't run. Mordekaiser wins by trading around Neeko's Tangle-Barbs and cashing the pattern: pull his misstep and win the Realm 1v1.
edits.after: She kites your slow kit — E-pull her step-up, then drag her into the Realm where she can't run. Mordekaiser wins by trading around Tangle-Barbs' 12s cooldown: pull her misstep and win the Realm 1v1.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Her Pop Blossom' and 'As Darkness Rise' — both FALSE POSITIVES; Pop Blossom is Neeko's R and Darkness Rise is Mordekaiser's passive. The real defect was the level chart: both layers read Neeko/Neeko/Skill x5 while the packet chart, the 55.3% win rate, the FAV 7/10 rating and the page's own whys all say Mordekaiser owns levels 2 through first item and Neeko takes over at 2+ items. All six rows proposed as one atomic paired group. IMPORTANT: brief.missingInteractions asserts Obliterate grounds Pop Blossom — I did NOT write that. Mordekaiser Q's 'grounding' flag comes from the phrase 'smashes the ground' and is a tooltip-parsing artifact, not a real grounding effect. Not asserted (kits do not cover it): whether Pop Blossom's knock-up can be interrupted mid-preparation, and whether Tangle-Barbs' root is reduced by tenacity.
